name: neon
description: Applies Finnomena's brand theme so any employee's vibe-coded apps and UI mockups automatically follow company branding, with a choice of depth: CSS-only colors/typography or the full Coinbase Design System (CDS). Ships neon-starter (scaffold a new project), neon-audit (recommends a theming depth for an existing project), neon-theme-css (colors/typography via CSS variables, no CDS), and neon-theme (full CDS).
